info.name: Student Mentor Dashboard API
info.description: Standalone collection for the Student Project Submission & Mentor Review API. Set baseUrl to your running API (default http://localhost:5000). If that backend's DATABASE_URL is configured for Neon, all API reads and writes use that Neon database; DIRECT_URL is for Prisma migrations, not Postman. The full workflow creates a Student and submissions, then approves/rejects them. These records and status changes remain in the configured database after the run. Use only a Neon database where you are authorized to keep these test records.

item.name: API root
item.description: Public service status endpoint.

exec: pm.test('identifies the API service', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.service).to.eql('Student Project Submission & Mentor Review API'); });

item.name: Health check
item.description: Public API health endpoint.

item.name: Reject invalid signup data
item.description: Signup accepts name, email, and password; this short password should fail validation.

item.name: Student signup
item.description: Signup always creates a STUDENT and sets the HttpOnly access_token cookie.

exec: pm.test('Student auth cookie is set', () => pm.expect(cookieMatch && cookieMatch[1]).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

item.name: Student profile after signup
item.description: Reads the authenticated user using the cookie captured from signup.

item.name: Reject invalid Student credentials
item.description: Wrong password returns the API credential error.

item.name: Student login
item.description: Logs in the newly created Student and captures its HttpOnly cookie value for explicit role switching.

exec: pm.test('Student auth cookie is set', () => pm.expect(cookieMatch && cookieMatch[1]).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

item.name: Create submission for approval demo
item.description: Creates a unique pending submission. Its ID is used in Video 2A.

item.name: Create submission for rejection and resubmission
item.description: Creates a second pending fixture for rejection and resubmission checks.

item.name: Reject duplicate pending repository
item.description: Repeats the first pending repository for this Student; duplicate is a 409 conflict.

item.name: List my submissions with search and pagination
item.description: Student-only list, searched and paginated on the server.

exec: pm.test('contains both workflow fixtures and pagination metadata', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.meta.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.meta.limit).to.eql(10); const ids = body.data.submissions.map((item) => item.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('approvalSubmissionId')); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('rejectionSubmissionId')); });

item.name: Read own submission detail
item.description: The owner Student can read its submission detail.

item.name: Reject invalid project data
item.description: Missing required project fields and invalid project name should fail validation.

item.name: Student cannot access Mentor list
item.description: The API enforces Mentor role server-side.

item.name: Mentor login
item.description: Uses credentials for an existing Mentor created by the backend seed. Sets the Mentor cookie.

exec: pm.test('Mentor auth cookie is set', () => pm.expect(cookieMatch && cookieMatch[1]).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

item.name: Mentor profile
item.description: Confirms the Mentor cookie authenticates as the seeded Mentor.

exec: pm.test('returns the Mentor profile', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data.user.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('mentorId')); pm.expect(body.data.user.role).to.eql('MENTOR'); });

item.name: Video 2A - Secure Route Demonstration
item.description: Run in order after Student Submissions and Mentor Authentication. Uses the real PATCH /api/mentor/submissions/:id/status route. Requests intentionally demonstrate auth, role, resource, validation, and state checks; the valid review changes a disposable submission.

item.name: 1. Status update without authentication
item.description: An empty access_token cookie is treated as unauthenticated; expected 401.

item.name: 2. Student attempts Mentor-only status update
item.description: A valid Student session is authenticated but does not pass authorizeRoles(MENTOR); expected 403 and no state change.

item.name: 3. Mentor reviews an existing pending submission
item.description: A valid Mentor session reviews a pending fixture; reviewer identity is taken from the verified cookie JWT, not request body.

exec: pm.test('status is approved and reviewer comes from the authenticated Mentor', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.submission.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(body.data.submission.reviewedBy.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('mentorId')); });

item.name: 4. Status update for a nonexistent submission
item.description: A well-formed UUID with no matching record returns 404 SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND.

item.name: 5. Invalid status/body validation
item.description: PENDING is not an allowed review decision; validation returns 400 before a database update.

item.name: 6. Repeat update after review
item.description: The same submission is already approved; conditional update rejects a second review with 409.

item.name: Mentor statistics before rejection
item.description: Stores aggregate counts so the rejection/resubmission flow can check count deltas.

exec: pm.test('statistics contain consistent status counts', () => pm.expect(stats.total).to.eql(stats.pending + stats.approved + stats.rejected));

item.name: Search and filter pending submissions
item.description: Server-side search/status filter returns the remaining pending fixture with pagination metadata.

exec: pm.test('only matching pending rows are returned', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.submissions.length).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.data.submissions.every((item) => item.status === 'PENDING')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.submissions.map((item) => item.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('rejectionSubmissionId')); pm.expect(body.meta.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.meta.limit).to.eql(10); });

item.name: Mentor reads submission detail
item.description: Mentor is permitted to read the shared detail endpoint.

item.name: Reject pending submission with feedback
item.description: A rejection requires a non-empty reviewNote; this request intentionally changes the fixture to REJECTED.

exec: pm.test('rejection and feedback are stored', () => { pm.expect(body.data.submission.status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(body.data.submission.reviewNote).to.eql('Please add setup instructions before resubmitting.'); });

item.name: Student can see rejection feedback
item.description: The owning Student can read review status and feedback after mentor rejection.

exec: pm.test('student sees rejection note', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(body.reviewNote).to.eql('Please add setup instructions before resubmitting.'); });

item.name: Filter approved submissions
item.description: Server-side Approved status filter.

exec: pm.test('approved filter returns the approved Video 2A fixture', () => { pm.expect(body.data.submissions.every((item) => item.status === 'APPROVED')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.submissions.map((item) => item.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('approvalSubmissionId')); });

item.name: Filter rejected submissions
item.description: Server-side Rejected status filter.

exec: pm.test('rejected filter returns the rejection fixture', () => { pm.expect(body.data.submissions.every((item) => item.status === 'REJECTED')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.submissions.map((item) => item.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('rejectionSubmissionId')); });

item.name: Resubmit rejected repository
item.description: The repository duplicate key is cleared on rejection, so its owner can create a new pending submission.

exec: pm.test('resubmission is pending and has a new ID', () => { pm.expect(body.data.submission.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(body.data.submission.id).not.to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('rejectionSubmissionId')); });

item.name: Approve resubmitted project
item.description: Mentor approves the new submission created after rejection.

item.name: Verify final mentor statistics
item.description: Checks net status count changes from the snapshot taken after the Video 2A approval.

exec: pm.test('counts reflect rejection and approved resubmission', () => { pm.expect(stats.pending).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('pendingBeforeReject')) - 1); pm.expect(stats.approved).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('approvedBeforeReject')) + 1); pm.expect(stats.rejected).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('rejectedBeforeReject')) + 1); });

item.name: Student sees final resubmission review
item.description: Confirms the owning Student can see final approval and feedback.

exec: pm.test('student sees approved resubmission feedback', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(body.reviewNote).to.eql('Thank you for addressing the feedback.'); });

item.name: Student logout
item.description: Clears the Student access_token cookie.

item.name: Mentor logout
item.description: Clears the Mentor access_token cookie.
